tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Apple and OpenAI are heading to court in a high-stakes dispute over trade secrets, reported by Bloomberg.
OpenAI and Google are pushing new artificial intelligence models that researchers say can be easily tricked into making nudes, reported by Ars Technica.
Anthropic had a rogue police tip, and there's a story about Garfield playing Altman, reported by Reuters.
China-market iPhones are adding three artificial intelligence model filings as Apple Intelligence nears a mainland launch, reported by BigGo Finance.
A Revenue Growth Agent has launched a Model Context Protocol Connector that brings company-specific sales intelligence into ChatGPT and Claude, reported by PR Newswire.
Free every hour.
